text: Blue Velvet copy, day look, two leftovers: 1) the picket trim along the top bar is still lavender. It's the SVG picture fence-day.svg (and check rail-day.svg, lid-day.svg, card-new-day.svg, send-day.svg too). Look at each, then recolour the lavender/pink in the SVG text to the theme's blues and save it back under the same .svg name. 2) The bat-wing heart sticker (st-heartbat.webp) is still lilac/pink; make it blue like you did the bow and skull, and look at the result before saving. Also delete the two helper scripts you left in the app folder during round 3 if they're still there. Don't leave new files behind.
